department: Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences (SEAS)

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 at 5:00 pm (US Eastern).

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics or Physics Subject Test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Mathematics or Physics Subject Tests: Optional

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is optional.

supervisor.value: You are admitted to work with a specific SEAS faculty member who has agreed to advise and fund you; contacting faculty before applying is encouraged but not required.
supervisor.quote: PhD students are admitted to work with a faculty member who has agreed to advise the student and support them financially through their PhD. | We encourage serious-minded candidates (i.e. those who have a clear sense of what they would like to do and with whom they would like to work) to get in touch with relevant faculty to discuss their research plans, but it is not a required part of the application.

also.quote: When a student enters the PhD program, they are assigned a primary advisor based on the research interests they expressed in the application.

funding.value: All GSAS PhD students get guaranteed funding for the first five years; your admitting SEAS advisor has committed to supporting you financially.
funding.quote: Our financial aid program features guaranteed funding for the first five years to all PhD students

also.quote: PhD students are admitted to work with a faculty member who has agreed to advise the student and support them financially through their PhD.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree in the natural sciences, mathematics, computer science or engineering.
entry_route.quote: Students with bachelor’s degrees in the natural sciences, mathematics, computer science, or engineering are invited to apply for admission.

also.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)

notes: Apply to "Engineering and Applied Sciences" and choose "PhD Engineering Sciences: Bioengineering" as the area of study; complete the Supplemental SEAS Application Form. Only one SEAS PhD application per year.
name: Bioengineering (PhD Engineering Sciences)
